verdict.line: You lose short trades from level 1 to roughly 6 to his E-into-Q burst, but win the lane once your HP stacking comes online past level 11.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's kit is built to win short trades (E dash, then Q swings, then an empowered Deathbringer Stance auto) before Mundo's regen passive and HP-stacking build have enough health behind them to matter, which is exactly why the measured head-to-head sits at 46.6% over 466 games despite Mundo's healthy overall 50.2% win rate across 20,133 games. His power is front-loaded into landing that combo; yours is back-loaded into a growing health pool, so the matchup is a race between his burst windows and your scaling.

theirWindow.when: Right after his E (Umbral Dash) lands
theirWindow.what: He dashes into range with E then follows with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and an empowered Deathbringer Stance auto for the real damage. Don't facetank it — get behind a minion or step out of his melee range immediately.

yourWindow.when: Once his E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no dash to disengage or reposition for several seconds, so commit to your own trade — throw Q (Infected Cleaver) and keep W (Burning Agony) active, since he can't easily pull away from your damage.

start.why: Blocks a chunk of his single-target auto/Q trade damage and sustains you through early poke — the higher-pick-rate start (65.1% pick, 46.2% WR over 366 games) and the one suited to a matchup decided by short physical trades.

boots.why: Best measured result into this matchup (52.6% over 268 games) — the extra movement speed lets you reposition around his Umbral Dash engages rather than trading face to face.

core.why: Converts the max health you're stacking straight into AD, which is the highest-performing rush into this matchup (70% WR over 20 games).
Massive HP pool that both amplifies Heartsteel's AD conversion and feeds your Adrenaline Rush regen passive.
Boosts your regen and healing while adding magic resist against the bonus magic damage on his Deathbringer Stance empowered auto.

situational.when: you need early grievous wounds to cut into his deathbringer stance and umbral dash healing
he's sustaining through fights off his passive and e healing and you need to shut it down
the lane has stabilized and you want more wave clear and auto-attack damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Triggers off autos in the extended trades this matchup forces, converting your huge HP pool into bonus max-health damage and healing — it rewards the long fight your build is scaling toward, not his short burst window.

summoners.why: The highest-pick combo (48% pick, 47.7% WR) — Flash to dodge the follow-up after his W (Infernal Chains) lands, Teleport to reset back into lane since you're on the losing side of early trades and need to keep farming safely.

playing.title: Trade after his E lands
playing.detail: Once he's dashed in with E (Umbral Dash), it's on cooldown and he can't easily disengage — commit Q (Infected Cleaver) and hold W (Burning Agony) active through the exchange.

playing.title: Clear his W chain zone fast
playing.detail: Infernal Chains has 825 range and drags you back to the impact point if you don't leave fast enough; stepping out before the second hit denies his whole combo.

playing.title: Farm behind minions
playing.detail: Stay behind the wave so his autos, Q swings, and empowered Deathbringer Stance auto have to go through creeps before they reach you.

playing.title: Poke with Q at range
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver's 4s cooldown and max-health scaling let you chip his health bar for free any time he's outside melee range instead of walking up to trade.

playing.title: Keep W running in extended fights
playing.detail: Burning Agony's 1s cooldown means it can stay active as constant damage once your HP pool from Warmog's/Heartsteel can cover the cost.

playing.title: Save Sadism to punish, not initiate
playing.detail: R (Sadism) is on a 75s cooldown — use the movement speed and regen to run him down after he whiffs his combo or to escape a bad trade, not to start one.

playing.title: Back off when he's charging an empowered auto
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance periodically empowers his next basic attack with bonus magic damage and a heal off your max health; if he's holding an auto back, give ground rather than let him land it.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the tactical reading of why those numbers happen — the combo timing, trade windows, and scaling pattern — is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of his (E)-(Q)! Be careful of his (W) as he can follow up with his full combo. Stay behind minions or move out of the way while farming lane!
